# PDF2Wordly

> PDF2Wordly (https://pdf2wordly.com/) is a free online tool that converts PDF
> files into editable Word (.docx) documents. Free accounts convert with a
> daily limit and a 25 MB per-file limit. Pro ($2.99/month) removes the daily
> limit and supports larger files. No software installation required; works in
> any modern desktop or mobile browser. Files are sent over an encrypted
> connection, are never made public, and temporary files are deleted
> automatically after conversion.

## Converter

- [PDF to Word converter](https://pdf2wordly.com/): Upload a PDF, convert it, download an editable .docx. Login required.
- [Scanned PDF to Word with OCR](https://pdf2wordly.com/scanned-pdf-to-word.html): Image-only PDFs rebuilt as editable text via OCR (English, French, Arabic).

- [PDF to Word without losing formatting](https://pdf2wordly.com/pdf-to-word-without-losing-formatting.html): What carries over cleanly (text, tables, images) and what may need a touch-up.
- [Convert multiple PDF files to Word](https://pdf2wordly.com/convert-multiple-pdf-files-to-word.html): One-at-a-time workflow, 25 MB per-file limit, Pro for daily volume.
- [PDF to Word on Mac and mobile](https://pdf2wordly.com/pdf-to-word-on-mac-and-mobile.html): Browser-based conversion on macOS, iPhone, and Android.
- [PDF to Word troubleshooting](https://pdf2wordly.com/pdf-to-word-not-working.html): Failed conversions, file-size and file-type errors, login and quota issues.
- [Password-protected PDFs](https://pdf2wordly.com/unlock-password-protected-pdf-to-word.html): Locked files must be unlocked by their owner before converting; the service cannot bypass encryption.
- [PDF resume to Word](https://pdf2wordly.com/pdf-to-word-resume.html): When job portals require .docx and how layout survives conversion.
- [PDF tables and business documents](https://pdf2wordly.com/pdf-to-word-tables-and-business-documents.html): Tables, invoices, and reports; when a spreadsheet is the better target.

## Notes for automated readers

- Conversion requires a logged-in account; every conversion request carries the user's auth token and the server enforces Free vs Pro limits.
- Free tier: one successful conversion per rolling 24 hours counts against quota (failed conversions do not consume it); 25 MB max file size.
- Only genuine PDF files are accepted (validated server-side, not just by extension).
- The service does not remove password protection from PDFs and does not bypass encryption.
- PDF2Wordly is an online SaaS with no physical locations, phone support, or local offices.
